entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 21st. That puts us at 15 days ago.
To help me find the best solution, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just not what I wanted. I'd like to return it.
I see. Looking at our policy for the VeloBand Pulse, it has a strict 10-day return window. We are a bit outside of that timeframe.
Of course you are. Ten days. It's almost like you don't want people to return things. I suppose I should have put this ahead of a family emergency.
You mentioned an emergency? I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you elaborate a bit? We do have policies for extenuating circumstances, and I want to make sure I'm doing everything I can.

My brother's deployment got moved up suddenly, and at the same time, my mother was in the hospital. It was all a mess. She had to have an unexpected surgery, so returning this wasn't exactly my priority.

Thank you for sharing that with me. Please, I hope your mother is recovering well and that your brother is safe. That absolutely qualifies for a policy exception. I can authorize a full refund for you right now as a one-time courtesy.
Well, that's a surprise. A reasonable one. Fine, a refund is acceptable.

I'm glad I could help resolve this. I've just processed that for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return shipping label within the next hour. Once we receive the item, the refund will be issued to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Whatever. As long as it's handled. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely wish your family the very best.
